headline: Emerytury do 5 tys. zł bez PIT. Co dalej z wielką obietnicą? Rząd wskazuje na miliardy
summary: The government says delivering on the promise of pensions up to 5,000 zlotys without income tax would cost the budget and local governments 58.6 billion zlotys annually, per Dziennik Gazeta Prawna.
why: Pension and tax policy shapes Poland's public finances, which matter for government borrowing and fiscal stability.
